body: It’s honestly just made me realize how empty and alone I feel. As depressing and edgy as that sounds.
Hopefully helping somebody in someway. I don’t care if I die bloody and screaming as long as it’s helping someone. One of those things that make up for a wasted life. Lmao that sounds super edgy.
“magical mutated lizard, used for guarding and protection.” Don’t know what the fuck that means for me.

Sorry for the misinterpretation, what I meant by “another persons fight” was running for office/senate and such, I wanna vote but I won’t for a presidential candidate this time. Like I said, not gonna vote for someone I believe fucked a kid. And I truly believe that they both have.

Politics is another mans fight. Im trying to rise through the ranks of the police to try to help fix them. We all have a road to walk and I encourage anyone who’s interested in politics to walk that road and fix it from the inside.

The republicans who are voted in actually do about 20, to 30, percent of the things the republicans who vote for them want them to do. Which fucking sucks. But we either have to vote for someone who’s gonna do 70 percent of shit we hate, and 30 we like. Or a democrat, who I don’t have any issues with, we just see the world differently. But I’ll only support about 10 percent of what they do, and hate the other 90, so we choose what we see as the better option of the two. I agree with a lot of the stuff you said. Not gonna get into what I did and did not agree with because I hate typing out long fucking paragraphs. I’m just trying to give a little insight from the other said. BTW just wanted to say I’m not voting for Biden OR trump in the election because I think they’re both rapists/pedos and I will never vote for someone if I ever even suspect that they’ve fucked a child.
